name: Apogee — Neural-Sync Dance & Social Club
description: Apogee clubs operate in Tier 3 nightlife districts with a core product: voluntary BCI-sync pools that allow groups of 8–40 dancers to share a low-fidelity emotional broadcast, creating waves of synchronized euphoria, rhythm-locked movement, and collective catharsis without chemical augmentation. The experience is described by regulars as 'being one body with forty heartbeats.' DJ-architects compose sets specifically for the sync-pool format, layering sonic frequencies against the broadcast signal to amplify shared emotional peaks.
story_hooks: During a sync pool session, one participant's BCI broadcasts something they didn't consent to share — a traumatic memory that floods the entire pool and leaves forty people unable to forget it.
A character realizes someone has been attending Apogee specifically to target them through the sync pool, using the shared emotional channel to map their psychology.
The original DJ-architect who designed Apogee's signature sync-pool format disappeared in 2214, and someone has been performing under their identity at underground venues ever since.
